items.source_en:
Great Serpent,

I've discovered where they are holding my cousins. I was even able to gain control over the system that governs the security locks. I could easily free them, but dealing with the patrolling Zealots would be a different story.

Mihael brought in a couple of new "assets" today. I heard him refer to them as "Redeemed."
